name: Milk substitute (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Milk substitute [Baking goods] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 171264 (SR Legacy, Milk substitutes, fluid, with lauric acid oil; NDB 01050)
provenance.curation_notes: Composition maps to USDA 'Milk substitutes, fluid, with lauric acid oil' (FDC 171264 / SR Legacy NDB 01050); the lauric-dominant fatty-acid profile (coconut/lauric oil) and Glu/Pro-rich amino-acid profile (sodium caseinate) confirm the identity. Dominant carbon/energy sources are total carbohydrate (6.16 g/100g, likely sucrose/corn-syrup solids but not sugar-resolved by USDA) plus the lauric-oil fat fraction; this is an unfermented processed product so no organic acids are characteristic or repo
curation_added: L-phenylalanine, L-valine, L-serine (amino acids absent from FooDB list)
myristic, palmitic, stearic, oleic, linoleic acids (only C8/C10/C12 were present)
full quantitative mineral panel (K, Na, P, Ca, Mg, Zn, Mn, Cu, Se) and B1/B2 amounts
flag: individual fermentable sugars are NOT resolved by USDA for this item (total carbohydrate 6.16 g/100g only)

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
